NotoSansSC.subset: pyftsubset of the Noto Sans SC variable font kept the wght axis (100-900), the face names, and every non-CJK glyph from the previous subset, including CJK punctuation and fullwidth forms. The horizontal header and USE_TYPO_METRICS bit match that previous face so line heights stay stable. CJK Unified Ideographs cover the 8105 characters of the 2013 Table of General Standard Chinese Characters (通用规范汉字表, State Council of the PRC, Guo Fa [2013] No. 23, promulgated 2013-06-05; scripts/tongyong-8105.txt) plus every zh-CN catalog character. The character list is levels 1, 2 and 3, in that order, from https://github.com/shengdoushi/common-standard-chinese-characters-table. scripts/check-zh-font-glyphs.py fails the build when one of those characters is missing. Characters outside that set may use the platform fallback.
